info.name: AI in Talk: voice
info.summary: Text-to-speech with Piper on the server's CPU, for the spoken replies of AI in Talk
info.description:
Nextcloud's text-to-speech ("Generate speech") spoken by [Piper](https://github.com/OHF-Voice/piper1-gpl) on the server's CPU, in German, Polish and English, as MP3. Nothing leaves the server: the voices are in the image.
[AI in Talk](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/talk_ai) uses it to answer voice messages by voice too; the Assistant's "Generate speech" can use it as well. The optional input "language" chooses the voice; "auto" reads it from the text.
Install it with AppAPI (a deploy daemon, e.g. HaRP).
info.author: Dawid Ciepiela
